blocks.text: Architecting a Modern Workplace for a Leading Real Estate Developer
Real Estate

blocks.alt: a laptop computer sitting on top of a desk next to a calculator

blocks.text: Client
A leading player in the real estate market in India, managing multi-billion dollar projects.
Ambition
To upgrade their legacy messaging and collaboration infrastructure to a modern, secure, and mobile-first platform to support their expanding operations.
Outcome
Architected and migrated the client from a dated infrastructure to a modern collaboration platform, delivering a superior and secure mobile experience for their entire workforce.
The Ambition
A leading player in the real estate market in India, managing multi-billion dollar projects.
The Challenge

Their legacy messaging infrastructure was a major bottleneck. It could not meet the increasing demands for mobility and security. The IT department was struggling to balance the need for a secure system with the workforce's desire for flexible access, all while trying to support their growth and expansion plans.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to empower their workforce with modern tools that matched the scale and prestige of their projects. They needed a secure, scalable, and reliable collaboration system that provided anytime, anywhere access to critical information for their highly mobile workforce, including senior management.
Ambition, Realized

The project was a complete success, culminating in a superior experience for the entire organization. To ensure full value was realized, our team provided comprehensive business productivity sessions to maximize end-user adoption and productivity. The new platform provided the secure, mobile-first experience their workforce demanded, while giving the IT team the control and peace of mind they needed.
Key Business Impact
Modernized a Legacy Collaboration Infrastructure
Enabled a Secure 'Work from Anywhere' Mobile Experience
Drove User Adoption with Business Productivity Training
Exceeded Customer Expectations at All Organizational Levels
Back to Happy Customer Back to Happy Customer
